# David G. Smith - Technical Architect & Strategic Advisor

> David G. Smith is a data scientist, cloud architect, author, and strategic advisor based in Washington, DC[cite: 1]. He specializes in federal technology modernization, AI, geospatial intelligence, and critical thinking[cite: 1].

* **Projects:** Led architectural modernization for the USGS Water Quality Portal Migration and the EPA's Envirofacts Cloud-Native Rebuild within the DMAP/AWS environment.
* **Books:** Author of "Critical Thinking: A Practical Guide to Seeing Through Bias, Noise and Manipulation" (Published Aug 2026).
* **Focus:** Helps federal organizations, business leaders, and organizations with complex data turn technology into better decisions.

- [Books Showcase](https://davidgsmith.net/books.html): Author catalog and forthcoming publications.
- [Critical Thinking Manual](https://davidgsmith.net/critical-thinking.html): 468-page comprehensive guide on cognitive biases, logic, media defenses, and AI chatbot sycophancy.
